reason: The owner has no executable Runtime interface; execFile is injectable but native filesystem creation, writes, links, fsync, reads and identity, UUID generation and separate-process scheduling have no supplied bindings. A command fixture alone cannot drive the public boundary deterministically. No check-only API is proposed.

cases.name: run creation or write/sync failure
cases.expected: After intent creation, recovery_required and null assignment with attempted phase, safe available code or unavailable, preservation and no-repeat warning; no raw error text or path.

cases.name: issue claim/sync failure
cases.expected: Unconfirmed intent reports claim/sync and safe available code or unavailable, preserving intent and uncertainty.

cases.name: add failure and reconciliation failure
cases.expected: Recovery_required reports add and reconciliation evidence, including safe available codes or unavailable; no second add or deletion.

cases.name: lost add reply with verified original identity
cases.expected: Ready with verified original assignment and no repeated add.

cases.name: two distinct issues in separate processes
cases.expected: Both ready and isolated. On failure retain fixture and report its location, phase/error and bounded available resource and contention evidence; unavailable facts are unknown.
